MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The fitting sealant felt relevant because my hose clamps and adhesives suggest an interest in supplies for securing and sealing repairs.",
    "A small bottle of sealant felt like a plausible addition to my repair supplies without requiring a new tool or a large stock of parts."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Finish nails, precisely sized rivets and the rivet-nut bit require particular jobs or compatible tools that my purchases do not establish.",
    "My electrical connectors do not mean I need tiny electronics screws or a replacement appliance plug; those solve different, specific problems.",
    "The surveillance signs did not fit my inspection-camera purchase, which suggests looking inside hard-to-reach spaces rather than monitoring a property."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treated practical repair supplies as a reason to offer almost any hardware, even when its purpose was unrelated.",
    "My purchases of some multipacks seemed to be taken as interest in large quantities generally, but I would need a clear use for 500 feet of cable or a large anchor assortment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Repeated hose-clamp purchases give me a more concrete connection to securing hoses and fittings than to carpentry or specialized metal fastening.",
    "I choose supplies for particular needs, so possible usefulness alone is not enough to make magnets, mounting anchors or specialized replacement parts appealing now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical repairs but stretched it too broadly beyond the specific repair needs reflected in my purchases."
}
